hadith:
Prostration - Narrated by 'Ata' bin Yasar -  Volume 2, Book 19, Number 178 

I asked Zaid bin Thabit about prostration on which he said that he had recited An-Najm before the Prophet, yet he (the Prophet) had not performed a prostration.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Baasit - الْبَاسِطُ - The Reliever

The name Al Baasit originates from the Arabic root word 'b-s-t', which conveys the concept of spreading or expanding. In Islamic tradition, it reflects Allah’s role in providing for His creation and ensuring that resources, both spiritual and material, are sufficiently available. This name highlights the boundless nature of Allah's provision and mercy.
verse:
Al-Masad - The Palm Fiber - 111:1

May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish!
